The dev's step-0 reading on `main` `351c22c9`: the dataset query door has no closed query set, so `POST /analytics/dataset/query?callerPackage=X` is accepted and ignored today (200, the bare read). After this card, `?callerPackage=` with `?package=`, with an uninstalled id, or for a dataset outside X's closure moves 200 → 400/409. That is a new refusal on an existing door, so the seat rules `yes (narrowing)` with FROM → TO and the measured first-party census (senders of `callerPackage`: 0, repo-wide including `ui/`). `/meta/dataset/:name` already refuses the unknown parameter, so there the arm is a pure widening, declared beside the narrowing. An uninstalled caller package reuses what `?package=` answers for it today (`409 not-held-by-qualifier` naming the holders, `404` when nothing holds the name). `Metadata-protocol: added` is unchanged. Nothing else in the claim changes.

Delivered · 2026-11-11T00:05Z

PR #32337 merged (`3c1b8c74`, 2026-11-10T23:12Z). `POST /analytics/dataset/query`, the batch door and `GET /meta/dataset/:name` take `?callerPackage=<package id>`: the dataset name resolves by ADR-0150 D3 for that reader (its own item, then the unique holder in its closure plus `sys`, else `409` naming the candidates) and is then read as `?package=HOLDER`; an uninstalled reader gets the `?package=ID` answer, never the bare read. The client's `queryDataset`, `queryDatasetBatch` and `meta.getItem` take a `callerPackage` option. Declared narrowing on the query doors (a malformed or unresolvable arm, accepted and ignored before, now refuses), census 0. Waiters: #32311 (ui#2 seat switches the dashboard, report and list-chart callers to `callerPackage`), now unblocked. Follow-up: #32362 (ADR-0150 amendment). Nothing left on this card; `pm:dispatched` and `pm:blocking` removed.
